arguments.query: SELECT p.product_id,p.sku,p.product_name,SUM(oi.quantity) q FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE p.is_active=1 AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_ts>='2024-12-31 16:00:00' AND o.order_ts<'2025-03-31 16:00:00' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 5
